blocks.en: The proof is obtained by seeking the minimum of the function \[b\mapsto a^p/p+b^q/q-ab.\] See Problem~\ref{ex:young-conjugate-exponents-inequality}. As a consequence of Lemma~\ref{lem:young-conjugate-exponents-scalar-inequality}, we shall now establish Hölder\textquotesingle s inequality.
blocks.zh: 对函数 \[b\mapsto a^p/p+b^q/q-ab.\] 求最小值即可得到证明. 见 Problem~\ref{ex:young-conjugate-exponents-inequality}. 现在由 Lemma~\ref{lem:young-conjugate-exponents-scalar-inequality} 建立 Hölder 不等式.
